scope: Post-hoc descriptive subgroup analysis of the same 1,482 held-site windows and 40 frozen fits. Both groups use exactly five observed inputs. Group membership is an annotation-timing property of the same clip/person ID. Physical entry, occlusion and unseen-site performance were not measured.

groups.first_sampled_annotation: Five-frame input begins at the first sampled annotation of this person ID in this clip.
groups.at_least_35_preceding_samples: At least 35 consecutive 10 Hz annotations of this person ID immediately precede the five inputs.

metrics: ADE averages all 30 Euclidean displacement errors, FDE scores step 30, both in metres. The oracle selects the minimum true ADE after observing the future; its FDE uses that same path.
aggregation: Within each subgroup, mean windows within each site; weight the four sites and five seeds equally.

paired_intervals.method: Average paired differences over the five fixed seeds per window. Sample whole clips with replacement within each site and include all subgroup windows in each sampled clip. Use identical draws across methods and metrics, then take percentile intervals. These intervals condition on these sites, fitted models and the annotation-history subgroup.
